history.summary: 05-where-to-put-the-ai-money.html 7/10. A newcomer would struggle most with rival-driven bets: the lesson first treats a rival's move as a good reason to invest in a defence bet, then the takeaways say a rival's announcement is never a reason to fund.

01-what-ai-agents-can-do.html 8/10, 02-the-genai-map.html 8/10, 03-llms-pros-cons-risks.html 8/10, 04-who-sells-what-in-ai.html 7/10, 05-where-to-put-the-ai-money.html 6/10, 06-sponsor-by-deciding.html 7/10. A newcomer would struggle most with the money and sponsor lessons, where a scoring table and a promised list of six ideas do not match what the page shows.

12-org-governance-and-hiring.html 7/10. A newcomer would struggle most with terms and names that shift between sections: a new shop name in one quiz, a product owner who is never named, and jargon like pilot and AI system used before it is explained. Fixes added to the lesson PR.

05-where-to-put-the-ai-money.html 7/10. A newcomer would struggle most with the scoring step: the value, effort and risk marks have no stated scale or direction, so the table's numbers feel arbitrary until the reader works it out. Fixes added to the lesson PR.

01-what-ai-agents-can-do.html 7/10. A newcomer would struggle most with the loop picture, which did not show a loop, and with several named colleagues who appear before anyone says who they are. Fixes added to the lesson PR.

08-what-an-agent-really-costs.html 7/10. A newcomer would struggle most with the cost sums: the lesson uses the word model before explaining it, and the S$0.30 figure means one thing in Step 2 and another in the quiz. Fixes added to the lesson PR.

09-rag-or-fine-tuning.html 7/10. A newcomer would stall on the word 'prompt' and on not knowing who Mr Tan and Devi are, and would not know how the 'twenty questions' comparison gets judged. Fixes added to the lesson PR.
04-who-sells-what-in-ai.html 7/10. Fixes added to the lesson PR.

10-scaling-laws-for-business.html 7/10. A newcomer would struggle most with what makes a model 'bigger' and why bigger costs more per call, because model size and cost are used before they are explained. Fixes added to the lesson PR.

13-a-roadmap-with-room-for-research.html 7/10. A newcomer would most struggle with how one piece of work, invoice handling, is sorted as a sure win in one step and an uncertain experiment in another, plus a few projects and names that appear without introduction. Fixes added to the lesson PR.

02-the-genai-map.html 7/10. A newcomer would struggle most with the jargon used before it is explained, such as RAG, API, GPU and the agent loop, and with the hawker analogy, which never says which role matches which layer. Fixes added to the lesson PR.

15-proving-roi.html 7/10. A newcomer would get lost in the money sums: the $2,400 saving appears with no working, the hard and soft split is used before it is clearly named, and ROI is never spelled out in English. Fixes added to the lesson PR.
